title: He scrubbed toilets at a boarding school in Kentucky, every day. He was nine.
caption:
He scrubbed toilets at a boarding school in Kentucky, every day. He was nine.

His parents had sent him from Thailand with almost nothing. At 15, he washed dishes at Denny's.

In 1993, in a Denny's booth, he and two friends started Nvidia. The first chip flopped. Sega's $5 million and one new chip saved it.

In 2025, it became the first company worth $5 trillion.

That kid is Jensen Huang. Forbes puts his net worth at $182.9 billion.

Who believed in you before anyone else did?
